label: HigherGov
terms_note: Subscription product with a free tier; api_key query param; custom plans; HigherGov terms.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** for search (REST, api_key). Lane `assist` → **api for search**. Confidence high.
reference.limits: - Subscription tiers; no numeric rate limit read.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: HigherGov API key (account admins: gear icon → API, per https://www.highergov.com/api-external/docs/).

config_fields.name: search_id
config_fields.help: Optional HigherGov SearchID of a saved opportunity search; the API has no keyword parameter, so filtering is done by a saved search.

adapter.rate_note: 'All subscriptions include base usage of 10,000 records per month.' No per-second limit is published. One request per second.

search_postings.note: GET /api-external/opportunity/ (federal contract, DIBBS, grant and state/local opportunities; updated every 30 minutes): page_number, page_size ≤ 100, optional search_id from config. No keyword, category or budget parameter exists, so query/category/min_budget are not sent. val_est_low/high are strings (raw); source_path links to the source notice.

get_posting.note: Same list endpoint filtered by opp_key (the HigherGov opportunity key returned as id); an unknown key yields an empty list (invalid_input).

not_offered.me: No account endpoint in the OpenAPI schema; the api_key is a query parameter.
not_offered.submit_bid: HigherGov is a market-intelligence database; offers go to the contracting agency named in the notice.
not_offered.credits: Record usage is a monthly subscription allowance; no usage endpoint is documented.

evidence: probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific

HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/2 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; names not found on the page: get_posting:opp_key, search_postings:page_number, search_postings:page_size, search_postings:search_id
